note: Same driver instrument and fixture as m6-r33-begin-split, with the port's allocator keeping up to 32 released spans (<=1 MiB each, <=8 MiB total) for reuse. Every window still has one 0.8-2.1 s hitch (periods 64:1), so window-mean ms are inflated; per-call costs are quoted.
